from __future__ import annotations
from typing import Any
from dataclasses import dataclass


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class SoloData:
    status: str
    kind: str
    level: int | None = None
    mode: Any = None
    version: str = None
    flag: str = None

    @classmethod
    def from_dict(cls, data: dict[str, Any]) -> SoloData:
        return cls(
            status=data.get("status"),
            kind=data.get("kind"),
            level=data.get("level"),
            mode=data.get("mode"),
            version=data.get("version"),
            flag=data.get("flag"),
        )

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "status": self.status,
            "kind": self.kind,
            "level": self.level,
            "mode": self.mode,
            "version": self.version,
            "flag": self.flag,
        }
